fields.label: Run ID
fields.description: Jarvis Chat Turn.name (run_id) this row attributes to. Not schema-unique: record_turn_usage's NEVER-raises contract must never fail an insert on a duplicate-key error, so any at-most-once guarantee is enforced by the caller (finalize's usage_recorded CAS), not by this table.

fields.label: User
fields.description: Snapshot of Jarvis Chat Session.user at write time (Data, not a Link, matching this table's other snapshot fields).

fields.label: Profile Agent ID
fields.description: Jarvis Chat Session.profile_agent_id snapshot. Empty string means the main/full agent (no role profile).

fields.label: Profile Tier
fields.description: Jarvis Chat Session.profile_tier snapshot; defaults to "full" when the session carries no tier (pre-role-profile sessions).

fields.label: Model
fields.description: usage.resolved_model_identity(row) for this turn - the same decode the aggregate + per-model accrual use, so this row's credit can never disagree with them.

fields.label: Cache Read
fields.description: 0 when the gateway build in use does not report cache token fields on sessions.list rows (verified empty against a live gateway on 2026-08-17; re-check resolved_model_identity's neighbouring cache decode if a later runtime adds cache*Tokens keys).

fields.label: Cache Write
fields.description: See cache_read: 0 under the same no-cache-fields-reported condition.

fields.label: Cache Reported
fields.description: True only when the gateway row actually carried cache token fields for this turn. False means cache_read/cache_write are NOT a real zero measurement - the admin UI must render "n/a", not 0, when this is unchecked.

fields.label: Tool Calls
fields.description: Count of role=tool Jarvis Chat Message rows in this turn's conversation, seq-bounded between the turn's seed_message and assistant_message (Jarvis Chat Message carries no direct run/turn link - jarvis.chat.entities.entities_for_turn uses the same seq-bounded idiom).

fields.label: Day
fields.description: Calendar day (site timezone) the turn was recorded, for daily rollups and the 90-day prune job.
